s.note: the dusty town near the border
s.how: Soak dried chillies and blend with orange juice and pineapple to a marinade. Coat 800g pork shoulder and roast at 160C for 3 hours. Slice and crisp in a hot pan. Serve in warm corn tortillas with diced pineapple, onion and coriander.

Halve 3 ripe avocados and smash roughly with a fork. Stir in the juice of 2 limes, a finely diced white onion, a chopped jalapeno and a handful of coriander. Season well with salt and serve straight away with warm corn chips for scooping.

m.note: a hot night in the border town
m.how: Marinate 800g skirt steak for 2 hours in lime juice, garlic, ground cumin and a little orange juice. Sear over very high heat for 3 minutes a side, rest and slice thin against the grain. Serve with long grain rice, warmed black beans and charred spring onions.

w.note: the coconut that, as he tells it, was free
w.how: Mix 250g desiccated coconut, 395g condensed milk, 2 egg yolks and 1 tsp vanilla. Spoon 20 small mounds onto a lined tray and bake at 170C for 18 minutes until golden on the edges. Cool on the tray until firm.

d.note: the bar where nobody wants a mariachi
d.how: Bury the bottles in a tub of ice for at least an hour before serving. Cut 2 limes into wedges. Open each bottle, push a wedge of lime into the neck and add a pinch of salt around the rim. Drink it cold, straight from the bottle.
